items.title: File Widerspruch against Krankengeld rejection
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, sent by simple post. Per the letter's own rule ('gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben', matching § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Sat 31.01.2026; for social-law letters this day does not shift for being a weekend. Counting the one-month Widerspruch period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), running to the same-numbered day one month later: Sat 28.02.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB). Since 28.02.2026 is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next business day, Mon 02.03.2026 (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG).

warnings: The letter states Krankengeld payments only start from 22.01.2026, meaning the period from 12.01.2026 (the stated start of incapacity) to 21.01.2026 is unpaid because the Arbeitsunfähigkeit notification arrived too late — verify the actual date the sick note was issued/sent versus the received-date claimed (22.01.2026) if you dispute the delay was your fault.
